output_contract.SUCCESS_SIGNAL_SCORE: Keep null; expose sourced chart rank/period/market as separate descriptive facts, never hit probability.
output_contract.EVIDENCE_CONFIDENCE: Qualitative coverage, provenance, measurement and transfer judgments with reasons and denominators.
output_contract.REFERENCE_MATCH_SCORE: Keep null until input observed; optional future descriptive distance may compare tempo with explicit half/double ambiguity, mode and structural timings. Never label similarity predicted success. No invented weights.
output_contract.NITIN_FIT_SCORE: Null until observed repeated singer audition data and explicit scoring rubric.
output_contract.EXPECTED_RETENTION_PROFILE: Null unless comparable platform-specific retention curves, denominators, timestamps and content versions are actually observed. Structural expectations alone are hypotheses.
output_contract.COMPARABLE_SONGS: Return only version-scoped matches with known-field coverage, source IDs, unresolved conflicts and cohort.

required_inputs: authorized original melody MIDI or measured pitch contour
vocal_key_optimizer.candidate_generation: Add one integer semitone offset to every pitched note; retain mode, contour, intervals, groove, meter and structure.
constraints: no extrapolation from artist reference key
no extrapolation from isolated extreme notes
protocol: Audition proposed chorus and climax at comparable moderate intensity.
Test nearby keys with breaks and self-reported effort.
Log actual pitches, duration, diction, stability and register behavior.
Nitin and Vatsal select creative fit after audition.
vocal_key_optimizer.note: No clinical vocal assessment or automatic key recommendation is claimed.

future_data_model.attribution: A shared ID establishes lineage, not causality. Link streams, subscribers, leads, bookings and revenue only with observed evidence; otherwise attribution is unknown. Separate gross/refund/net/currency. Deduplicate revenue events.
future_data_model.experiment_design: Pre-register edits, platform, audience/traffic allocation, time window and outcome; compare within recording where possible. Use actual exposure denominators. Do not pool short-video completion and full-song retention.

governance: No publication, deployment, private architecture claim, purchase, credentials or approval inferred.
